subject: Regulatory Shield pricing model and onboarding fee discussion
messages:
From: James Ellis <j.ellis@northerncare.org>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@northerncare.org
Date: 2028-06-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro — Regulatory Shield package pricing questions

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the audit trails and residency controls. Procurement and IT are now working through the commercials. We need a clear breakdown for the "Regulatory Shield" bundle (audit log retention tiers, KMS vs HSM options, EU residency path, HIPAA add-on).

Specific asks:
- Line-item pricing for audit log retention at 90/365/730 days
- KMS: per-key seat pricing vs usage-based; HSM: one-time onboarding seat vs monthly seat
- Data residency surcharge for EU region (estimated percentage or $/month) and migration timeline
- Any HIPAA-specific onboarding or SLA surcharge
- Can the implementation/onboarding fee be amortized as credits against monthly invoices? If so, how have you typically structured that?

We may be able to commit to a 12–24 month minimum if the economics look reasonable — interested in any commit/term discounts and prepay incentives.

Thanks — can you send a short written proposal + a sample amendment we can circulate internally?

Best,
James Ellis
VP, IT Operations
NorthernCare Health

---
From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: James Ellis <j.ellis@northerncare.org>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-26T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Regulatory Shield package pricing questions

Hi James — appreciate the clear list. I put together a short proposal and two commercial scenarios below; attaching a one-page pricing summary and an editable workbook for your procurement team.

Quick summary (high level):
- Audit logs: 90/365/730 day tiers at $0.12 / $0.08 / $0.05 per 1k events per month respectively. Longer retention reduces per-event cost; export available on request.
- KMS vs HSM: KMS keys billed at $15/key/month; HSM seat options: one-time onboarding fee $35k + $2,200/month for a reserved HSM instance OR pass-through model (customer procures HSM through partner at cost + Redwood management fee 8%).
- Data residency: EU residency surcharge 20% of base inference/infra cost for EU-hosted model endpoints; migration support estimated 4–6 weeks for standard workloads.
- HIPAA: HIPAA add-on + SOC2 evidence package $6,500/month; if customer requires dedicated SLA or higher retention of audit logs, we can scope an implementation uplift.
- Implementation/onboarding: standard SOW one-time $45,000 (covers SOC2 evidence collection, swimlanes, and HSM provisioning). We offer two amortization options: (A) apply the $45k as monthly credits evenly across first 12 months; (B) amortize over contract term (e.g., 24 months) with percentage applied to monthly invoices.

Committed-term incentives:
- 12-month commit: 10% off Regulatory Shield recurring fees for year 1.
- 24-month commit: 18% off + option to prepay 6 months and receive an additional 5% credit on prepayment.

Attachments: Regulatory_Shield_Pricing_2028Q2.pdf (summary) and NORTHERNCARE_RMP_MOD_2028.xlsx (editable scenarios). Also adding HubSpot deal and DocuSign amendment draft for your legal team.

Next steps: happy to walk through numbers with your procurement Monday — Ben (copied) can run a scenario using your estimated event volumes and model throughput. Tessa — can you confirm if finance prefers amortization as credits or invoice line-item?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Enterprise 
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123

From: James Ellis <j.ellis@northerncare.org>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@northerncare.org
Date: 2028-06-27T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Regulatory Shield package pricing questions

Thanks Laura — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from procurement/IT:

1) For HSM: our security team prefers vendor-managed HSM reserved instance but wants to understand the amortization of the $35k onboarding fee if we commit to 24 months. Would Redwood consider splitting that onboarding fee 50/50 (half as a one-time invoice, half amortized as monthly credits over 18 months)?

2) HIPAA add-on: $6.5k/mo is higher than we budgeted. If we commit 24 months and prepay 6 months, can that be reduced to $4.5k/mo?

3) EU residency: can Redwood provide a fixed $/month estimate per region rather than a % surcharge? Our finance team prefers predictability.

If you can propose two simple commercial scenarios (12m amortization vs 24m with a split onboarding and prepay concession), we'll take to legal and procurement.

Thanks,
James

---
From: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: James Ellis <j.ellis@northerncare.org>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Regulatory Shield package pricing questions

James — thanks. I ran the numbers based on a nominal footprint (50M events/month; 2 dedicated model endpoints with moderate throughput). Two scenarios below — rounded for clarity. I'm attaching a short calculation workbook to the Hub Drive link.

Scenario A — 12-month commit with onboarding fully amortized over 12 months:
- Audit logs (365d): $0.08 per 1k events => ~$4,000/mo
- KMS keys (50 keys): $15/key/mo => $750/mo
- HSM reserved (Redwood-managed): $35k onboarding amortized over 12 months => $2,917/mo + $2,200/mo reserved seat => $5,117/mo
- HIPAA add-on: $6,500/mo (no prepay)
- EU residency: flat $9,000/mo estimate for dedicated EU endpoints
- Total recurring (month 1): approx $25,367/mo. With 12-month commit discount (10%) => $22,830/mo. Implementation spread gives predictable cashflows.

Scenario B — 24-month commit with split onboarding (50/50) + 6-month prepay concession:
- Onboarding: $17,500 immediate invoice + $17,500 amortized over 18 months => $972/mo
- HIPAA concession: reduce to $4,500/mo if prepay 6 months (applies year 1)
- 24-month commit discount: 18% recurring discount applied to base recurring before residency surcharge
- EU residency: fixed $8,500/mo (per your ask)
- Total recurring (post-discount & prepay year 1) => approx $17,600/mo effective for months covered by prepay; overall blended ARR improves for Redwood and predictable for NorthernCare.

Notes:
- We can bake the $17,500 deferred credit as a contract amendment so it appears as a one-line credit on invoices rather than changing list prices.
- SOC2 evidence: Redwood can commit to sharing the evidence package within two weeks of contract signature; if you require an on-site audit or custom attestation, that would be scoped separately.

Link: pricing calc (internal) — https://drive.google.com/pricing-calc-northerncare

If that looks acceptable, Laura and I can get the amended quote and SOW started — Tessa, I flagged the deal in HubSpot (HS-2039482) and will draft the DocuSign amendment.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
